description: A COBOL word whose characters the COBOL 2002/2014 Annex B permits where they stand and the COBOL 2023 Annex B does not — Annex E.2 item 4: U+037A GREEK YPOGEGRAMMENI was deleted, and U+30FB KATAKANA MIDDLE DOT may no longer be a word's first or last character (B.3 item 3, medial only). Modeled as removedIn=2023: compiles at 2002/2014, rejected at 2023 (COBOL0902; --permissive downgrades to a warning and keeps the 2014 rule). Every other Annex B violation is COBOL2773 at every edition. kb/Work PB1402.
display: a character Annex B permitted in this position before COBOL-2023
citation: ISO §2023:8.3.2.1; Annex B.3 item 3; Annex E.2 item 4 (037A deleted, 30FB made medial)
